title: mxv/run/v1
description: Each task of the workspace: those that a manifest declares, then those that mise lists, by checkout.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

TaskRow.description: One task of a workspace, as `mxv run` lists it.

source.description: Where the task comes from: `mxv.toml` or `mise`.

checkout.description:
The folder of the checkout that holds it, or null for the workspace
manifest of a workspace with several checkouts.

gate.description: Whether it takes a place from deadband.
